moves.claimSummary: The motion concerns interventionist theism, not merely an unknowable designer.
moves.reasonSummary: Deism posits at most an initiating intelligence indifferent to later affairs, whereas theism adds revelation, providence, and a plan for individuals.

inferenceSummary.premise: Deism posits at most an initiating intelligence indifferent to later affairs, whereas theism adds revelation, providence, and a plan for individuals.

inferenceSummary.conclusion: Even if a designer is difficult to disprove, the much stronger theistic claim bears additional evidential burdens.

moves.speaker: Christopher Hitchens
moves.claimSummary: The destructive, expanding cosmos does not look like the intended product of a benign creator focused on humans.
moves.reasonSummary: Humanity occupies a tiny location in a universe where stars continually die and expansion accelerates toward dissolution.

inferenceSummary.premise: Humanity occupies a tiny location in a universe where stars continually die and expansion accelerates toward dissolution.
inferenceSummary.inference: If humanity occupies a tiny location in a universe where stars continually die and expansion accelerates toward dissolution. then the stated claim materially affects the assigned burden.
inferenceSummary.conclusion: The observed scale, waste, and destruction count against inferring a loving designer from the cosmos.

moves.importanceRationale: Directly challenges both design and goodness using the large-scale character of the world.

instructions: Read this complete packet and the complete assigned source.txt before drafting. This is a narrow repair of at most two moves, not an inventory or assessment. Keep every supplied semantic field immutable. Select the smallest contiguous event range inside the original range that supports the complete unchanged claim, every load-bearing reason/example in reasonSummary, and every material qualification or concession in inferenceSummary.conclusion. Do not stitch separated excerpts or silently omit a premise to meet 2200 characters. If the unchanged proposition cannot be supported, report the exact conflict instead of rewriting it.

For a range exceeding 2200 characters, identify the exact separated source components that require retaining its first and last events and the intervening text. Anchors must prove the relevant component, not just be adjacent words. All support-map ranges must be inside your chosen evidence range.

Give source-specific endpoint explanations and describe exactly which original prefix/suffix was removed and why it is dispensable. If unchanged, explain the indispensable endpoint content. Do not include arbitrary 20-event buffer windows. Cite event numbers, not generic references to context.

Supply 1..2 exact 3..18-word quotation candidates within the retained excerpt. Preserve fillers, repetitions and case. Prefer clear ungarbled wording. Quotation candidates may change only to fit the corrected source boundaries or avoid a caption garble; they must not invent participant wording.

Run the provided read-only checker on the full in-memory draft BEFORE final submission. It checks source exactness, anchors, bounds, keys and immutable identity. Fix draft/checking errors in memory before one final apply_patch write. Do not submit a known-invalid draft. The controller separately reviews semantic minimality; a machine pass alone is insufficient.

Write only the absolute outputPath, one final apply_patch submission; do not overwrite or write any temporary file.
